# MeshDoc

> MeshDoc is a 100% client-side web application for 3D printing mesh analysis, diagnostic reporting, automated watertight repair, normal orientation, volume-preserving smoothing, polygon decimation, and multi-format export for STL, 3MF, and OBJ files.

## Documentation

- [Application Interface](https://www.meshdoc.de/): Zero-upload browser-based 3D mesh diagnostics and repair engine.
- [Sitemap](https://www.meshdoc.de/sitemap.xml): Standard XML sitemap.
- [Source Repository](https://github.com/Exulizer/MeshDoc): Open source codebase and documentation.

## Core Capabilities

- [Mesh Diagnostics](https://www.meshdoc.de/): Non-manifold edge detection, boundary hole counting, Euler characteristic verification, volume and area measurement.
- [Automated Repair](https://www.meshdoc.de/): Ear-clipping planar hole-capping, outward normal re-orientation, degenerate triangle removal, and vertex welding.
- [Surface Smoothing](https://www.meshdoc.de/): Volume-preserving Taubin smoothing and sagitta curvature subdivision with sharp edge protection.
- [Polygon Decimation](https://www.meshdoc.de/): Aspect-ratio preserving centroid clustering polygon reduction with non-destructive base geometry.
- [Multi-Format Export](https://www.meshdoc.de/): Export repaired models as Binary STL, ASCII STL, 3MF Package, or Wavefront OBJ.
- [Material Calculation](https://www.meshdoc.de/): Filament weight in grams and length in meters for PLA, PETG, ABS, and TPU with customizable infill.

## Optional

- [Legal Notice](https://www.meshdoc.de/): Provider identification and legal information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.meshdoc.de/): 100% local processing guarantee with zero server uploads.
